actions.text: ASSUMING FIRST SPONSORSHIP - Ms. Tenney asked unanimous consent that she may hereafter be considered as the first sponsor of H.R. 7380, a bill originally introduced by Representative Swalwell of California, for the purpose of adding cosponsors and requesting reprintings pursuant to clause 7 of rule XII. Agreed to without objection.

Referred to the Committee on Foreign Affairs, and in addition to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

dimensions.assessment: Aims to affect journalists, human rights defenders, and civil society actors in Iran, alongside U.S. satellite licensees and federal agencies.
dimensions.evidence: deliver remote or in-person cybersecurity training to journalists, human-rights defenders, and civil-society actors in Iran

dimensions.assessment: Furnishes digital-safety tools, VPN services, and training while placing regulatory conditions on satellite operators regarding Iran coverage.
dimensions.evidence: furnish vetted open-source or commercially available digital-safety tools, including VPN services and end-to-end encrypted messaging applications

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $15 million for each of fiscal years 2027 and 2028 ($30 million total).
dimensions.evidence: authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary of State $15,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 and 2028

dimensions.assessment: Mandates coordination strategies across departments, introduces new FCC license conditions, and sets up training programs and reporting mandates.
dimensions.evidence: FCC shall... require that the licensee shall refrain from intentionally disabling, degrading, or geo-blocking satellite or DTC coverage

dimensions.assessment: Includes multi-year funding authorizations for FY 2027-2028 and ongoing 5-year reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: annually thereafter for 5 years, the Secretary of State shall submit... a report

missing_information: Total number of individuals in Iran expected to be reached by the training and tools
Specific names of commercial entities that may be impacted by FCC licensing conditions
importance_detail.rationale: Authorizes $15 million annually for fiscal years 2027 and 2028 for cybersecurity and internet freedom programs in Iran, and places conditions on FCC commercial satellite licenses regarding coverage over Iran.
